**Description**
This PR adds a toggle for a global builder dark theme. It also allows for customisation of the dark theme hue, saturation and lightness so it can be tweaked as desired. Theme preferences are persisted to local storage.

**Features**
- Toggle for dark mode
- Sliders for customising theme
- Local storage sync for theme persistence
- Lots of components updated to support theming properly

**Fixes**
- Fixed design settings `Checkbox` component not looking right in dark mode
- Fixed inconsistent icons for binding dropdowns between design and automation pages
- Fixed binding dropdown icons not looking right in dark mode
- Lots of other small CSS fixes to support theming
